_comment: Single source of truth for who works the Berlin kitchen.
This file is GENERATED. Do not hand-edit it.
The weekly scheduled task maintains the EMPLOYEES array inside index.html, as
it always has. CI (.github/workflows/thumbnails.yml) copies that array here on
every push, so this file follows index.html automatically and cannot drift.
Why it exists: kitchen-tasks.html used to carry its own roster, which froze in
April 2026 and went on offering shifts to people who had left while omitting
eight people who had joined. Both pages now read this one file.
